input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION
input.rationale: The cap is nominally mutual but the basis is narrow and illusory: only amounts "actually paid" by Corio and only "for the transaction which the liability relates to", with no greater-of USD 1,000,000 floor. Carve-outs are limited to Section 8 (IP indemnity); confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit inside the cap, and our fee obligations are not excluded. Redline resets the basis to 12 months' fees paid or payable / USD 1M and adds Excluded Claims.

input.quote: Commerce One shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio and its Customers from any and all damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) incurred by Corio or its Customers arising out of any claim that the Software infringes any patent, copyright, trademark or trade right secret of a third party
input.rationale: Commerce One gives a full third-party IP infringement defence and indemnity extending to us and our Customers, with the usual exclusions (use outside Documentation, third-party modification) and remedies (procure, replace/modify, terminate and refund), and Section 9 places Section 8 liability outside the cap. This meets the fallback position; there is no Customer-side indemnity to narrow. We may still ask for breach-of-law, data-breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct limbs if the deal reopens.
